record.question: The __________ may be defined as the representation of the earth’s pattern as a whole or a part of it.
record.explanation: A map is a scaled representation of the whole or part of Earth’s surface on a plane. A map projection is the transformation used to make that representation; it is not the representation itself. Reference: https://sathee.iitk.ac.in/pa/sathee-railway-exams/student-corner/ncert-books/class-11/geography/practical-work-in-geography/chapter-01-introduction-to-maps/. Original printed source and ordered choices independently reviewed. Verified worked solution, unofficial; no matching examiner key is asserted.
